description: Sequential task breakdown for Project 1: Knowledge Graph RAG swarm implementation

tasks.name: Environment & Infrastructure Setup
tasks.description: Initialize git repository within knowledge-graph-rag/, configure Python packaging and virtual environment with uv (pyproject.toml), configure docker-compose.yml for Neo4j (ports 7474, 7687) and PostgreSQL with pgvector (port 5432), and configure integration with _shared/ollama_helper.py without duplicating shared code.
test_targets: python -c "import sys; sys.path.append('../_shared'); import ollama_helper; print('Shared helper accessible')"
acceptance_criteria: Git repository initialized inside knowledge-graph-rag/ with appropriate .gitignore.
pyproject.toml specifies Python 3.11+ and all project dependencies (pgvector, psycopg2-binary, neo4j, openai, pydantic, fastapi, uvicorn, pytest, datasets, tqdm, python-dotenv).
Virtual environment (.venv) initialized using uv venv and synced.
docker-compose.yml defines Neo4j (ports 7474, 7687) and PostgreSQL + pgvector (port 5432) with healthy configurations and volume persistence.
src/config.py defines environment configurations and loads settings dynamically.

tasks.name: Vector Store & Embeddings Module
tasks.description: Implement recursive document chunking, Ollama embedding integration (nomic-embed-text, 768 dimensions), PostgreSQL + pgvector client with schema initialization, HNSW index creation with cosine similarity, and chunk retrieval with metadata filtering.
acceptance_criteria: src/chunker.py implements recursive character text splitting with configurable chunk size (~1000 chars) and overlap (~200 chars), assigning unique deterministic chunk_ids.
src/embeddings.py produces 768-dimensional embeddings using nomic-embed-text via Ollama API.
src/vector_store.py initializes document_chunks and entity_mentions tables with HNSW cosine index (vector_cosine_ops, m=16, ef_construction=64).
Provides functions to insert chunks, batch embed, perform cosine similarity search (top-k), and filter by metadata.

tasks.name: Knowledge Graph Module & Extraction Pipeline
tasks.description: Implement the Neo4j client with constraint and index initialization, domain ontology definition (Company, Person, Product, Location, FinancialMetric), LLM-based structured entity/relation extraction using Ollama, entity resolution with canonical normalization and alias merging, and a parameterized Cypher template registry.
acceptance_criteria: src/neo4j_client.py connects to Neo4j and initializes uniqueness constraints and indexes for canonical names and chunk_ids.
src/ontology.py defines Pydantic models for entities, relationships, and extraction schemas.
src/extractor.py extracts entities and relations from text chunks conforming strictly to the ontology schema.
src/entity_resolver.py normalizes names (stripping legal suffixes) and merges aliases into canonical nodes.
Graph ingestion uses idempotent Cypher MERGE queries; every relationship stores source_chunk_id.
src/cypher_templates.py provides safe parameterized query templates (shared suppliers, multi-hop paths, subsidiary chains, neighborhoods) preventing raw LLM Cypher execution.

tasks.name: Hybrid Retriever & Reranker/Fusion Module
tasks.description: Implement the lightweight query router (qwen2.5:1.5b), knowledge graph path traversal with statement serialization, backing chunk retrieval via source_chunk_id, and Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to combine vector search and graph retrieval streams.
acceptance_criteria: src/router.py classifies questions into VECTOR, GRAPH, or BOTH with a safe fallback to BOTH on uncertainty.
src/graph_retriever.py resolves entities, selects Cypher templates, serializes graph paths into verbalized statements, and fetches backing chunks by source_chunk_id.
src/fusion.py implements Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with constant k=60 to merge and rank vector chunks and graph backing chunks.
src/hybrid_retriever.py coordinates the routing, dual-channel retrieval, and fusion into a single queryable interface.

tasks.name: End-to-End RAG Generation Pipeline & API
tasks.description: Implement context assembly with labeled graph and text sections, answer synthesis with claim-level citations using qwen3:8b via Ollama, post-generation citation validation to detect hallucinated chunk IDs, and FastAPI REST API exposing query, ingestion, and health endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: src/generator.py constructs structured prompts with separated '=== Graph-Derived Relationships ===' and '=== Retrieved Text Passages ===' and calls qwen3:8b via Ollama.
Generated answers include per-claim citations formatted as [source: <chunk_id>].
src/citation_validator.py validates that every cited chunk_id exists in the retrieved context set and detects fabricated sources.
src/api.py provides FastAPI endpoints: POST /query, POST /index, and GET /health with latency metrics.

tasks.name: Comprehensive Test Suite
tasks.description: Author complete unit and integration tests under knowledge-graph-rag/tests/ covering all modules, mocks for offline testing, and end-to-end pipeline verification.
acceptance_criteria: All test files are stored under knowledge-graph-rag/tests/.
Unit tests exercise logic with mock fixtures so test suite can execute reliably.
Integration tests verify end-to-end flows against active services when available.
pytest passes with zero failures when executed by the verifier role.

tasks.name: MultiHopRAG Benchmark Evaluation Script
tasks.description: Author benchmark harness using a 100-item evaluation slice from Hugging Face 'yixuantt/MultiHopRAG' stratified by hop count (1-hop, 2-hop, 3-hop, aggregation). Evaluate accuracy, citation validity, and latency comparing Hybrid KG-RAG vs Vector-only baseline, and export comparative Markdown table.
acceptance_criteria: Curate a 100-item evaluation slice from MultiHopRAG dataset stratified into 1-hop, 2-hop, 3-hop, and aggregation categories.
multihop_benchmark.py runs both Vector-only baseline and Hybrid KG-RAG on all 100 items.
Records accuracy, p50/p95 latency, and citation precision per hop tier.
Generates benchmark_report.json and benchmark_table.md documenting the accuracy curve and latency tradeoff.
